  • Constructor Details

    • SectionOperatingBasis

      public SectionOperatingBasis(String isolationSectionId, String measuredEquipmentTag, String operatingCaseId, String operatingCaseRevision, String evidenceReference, double normalPressureBara, double maximumOperatingPressureBara, double designPressureBara, double fluidDensityKgPerM3, double maximumInflowKgPerS, double processSafetyTimeSeconds)
      Creates a section-specific operating basis.
      Parameters:
      isolationSectionId - DYN-C029 isolation-section identity
      measuredEquipmentTag - equipment carrying the proposed pressure measurement
      operatingCaseId - governing process/design case identity
      operatingCaseRevision - governing case revision
      evidenceReference - source calculation or report
      normalPressureBara - normal operating pressure in bara
      maximumOperatingPressureBara - maximum declared operating pressure in bara
      designPressureBara - declared design pressure in bara
      fluidDensityKgPerM3 - declared inventory density in kg/m3
      maximumInflowKgPerS - declared governing inflow in kg/s
      processSafetyTimeSeconds - externally established process safety time in seconds
